title: Torvia Motors to launch Aera electric crossover from its Sanand plant in Q1 2027
body: Torvia Motors on Tuesday announced the Aera, a five-seat electric crossover that will roll out of its Sanand plant from Q1 2027. The company plans to build 60,000 units in the first year and will source tyres, battery packs and power electronics locally to meet the government's localisation norms. Bookings open in December across 140 dealerships, and the company said it is finalising suppliers for low rolling resistance EV tyres over the next quarter.

title: Swiftline Logistics orders 1,200 electric cargo vans to expand urban fleet
body: Swiftline Logistics has placed an order for 1,200 electric cargo vans that will join its urban delivery fleet across Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Chennai over the next nine months. The fleet expansion is part of a plan to double same-day delivery capacity before the festive season. Swiftline's fleet head said the company is evaluating tyre and maintenance partners that can guarantee uptime and lower cost per kilometre for high-mileage vans.

title: Sanjeevani Hospitals raises USD 85 million to add four multi-specialty hospitals
body: Sanjeevani Hospitals has raised USD 85 million in a Series C round led by a healthcare-focused private equity fund. The chain will use the funding to open four new 250-bed multi-specialty hospitals in Pune, Nagpur, Indore and Raipur by the end of 2027, each with an in-house diagnostic laboratory, a cath lab and an oncology day-care unit. The group is also upgrading its laboratory information system across existing hospitals.

title: Prana Diagnostics to open 30 collection centres and a new reference laboratory
body: Prana Diagnostics will open 30 new sample collection centres across Gujarat and a central reference laboratory in Ahmedabad by March 2027. The laboratory will process 12,000 samples a day and is designed to meet NABL accreditation requirements from day one. The company said it is tendering for immunoassay and clinical chemistry analyzers along with a cloud laboratory information system.

title: Lumora Semiconductors wins incentive approval for INR 3200 crore OSAT plant in Dholera
body: Lumora Semiconductors has received central incentive approval for a INR 3,200 crore outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) facility in Dholera. The plant will package power discretes and battery management ICs for electric vehicle and solar inverter customers, with trial production planned for Q3 2027. Lumora said it will begin sourcing inline metrology and inspection equipment later this year.

title: Kestrel Silicon opens power electronics design centre in Bengaluru
body: Kestrel Silicon, a Singapore-based fabless chip company, has opened a 400-engineer design centre in Bengaluru focused on silicon carbide power modules for two-wheeler and commercial vehicle inverters. The company said the centre will work closely with Indian EV makers on localisation and plans to sign sourcing agreements with local module assemblers within the next two quarters.

title: Helio Textiles signs 25 MW solar PPA and plans battery storage for its Surat mills
body: Helio Textiles has signed a 25 MW power purchase agreement for a captive solar project and plans to add 10 MWh of battery storage at its three Surat mills as part of a net-zero pledge for 2032. The company expects commercial operation by June 2027 and is evaluating string inverter and energy management vendors for the rooftop portion of the project.

title: Nimbus Grid Data Centres to build 60 MW hyperscale campus with on-site solar
body: Nimbus Grid Data Centres will build a 60 MW hyperscale data centre campus near Chennai, with the first 20 MW phase going live in Q4 2027. The campus design includes 8 MW of on-site rooftop solar, a battery energy storage system for peak shaving and a long-term renewable power purchase agreement. The operator said procurement for the energy infrastructure will start this quarter.

title: KiranaKart opens 450,000 sq ft fulfilment centre in Bhiwandi ahead of festive season
body: Quick-commerce player KiranaKart has opened a 450,000 sq ft fulfilment centre in Bhiwandi to handle festive season demand across the Mumbai region. The facility has space for 38,000 pallet positions and will add automated sortation and robotic picking in a second phase next year. KiranaKart recently raised a Series B round and said it is evaluating a warehouse management system to run its growing network.

title: ColdArc Pharma Logistics to build vaccine cold-chain hub near Hyderabad
body: ColdArc Pharma Logistics will build a 120,000 sq ft temperature-controlled distribution hub near Hyderabad's pharma cluster, with ultra-cold storage for vaccines and biologics. The cold-chain expansion is backed by a USD 40 million investment and is expected to be operational by September 2027. ColdArc said it needs real-time temperature monitoring and route optimisation across its reefer fleet.
